Defines Go structs for deserializing Debian OVAL (Open Vulnerability and Assessment Language) XML definitions, mapping the full OVAL document hierarchy into typed Go structures.

## Key Components

| Type | XML Path | Description |
|------|----------|-------------|
| `Root` | `oval_definitions` | Top-level document container |
| `Definition` | `definitions > definition` | Individual vulnerability definition with metadata |
| `Criteria` / `Criterion` | `definition > criteria` | Nested test criteria tree |
| `Affected` / `Reference` | `definition > metadata` | Platform scope and CVE/DSA references |
| `Debian` | `definition > metadata > debian` | Debian-specific DSA info and dates |
| `Tests` | `tests` | Container for `dpkginfo_test`, `uname_test`, `textfilecontent54_test` |
| `Objects` | `objects` | Container for corresponding OVAL object definitions |
| `States` | `states` | Container for version/content state matchers |
| `DpkginfoTest` / `DpkginfoObject` / `DpkginfoState` | Various | Package presence and version checks |

## Usage Example

```go
import (
    "encoding/xml"
    "os"
    "github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/oval/debian"
)

func parseOVAL(path string) (*debian.Root, error) {
    data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
    if err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }

    var root debian.Root
    if err := xml.Unmarshal(data, &root); err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }

    for _, def := range root.Definitions.Definitions {
        // def.ID, def.Title, def.References, def.Criteria
        _ = def
    }
    return &root, nil
}
```

## Notes

- `Criteria` is self-referential, supporting arbitrarily nested `criteria` trees via `[]Criteria`
- `DpkginfoState.Evr` captures EVR (Epoch:Version-Release) comparisons used for Debian package version matching
- All structs use `encoding/xml` tags exclusively — no JSON serialization is defined
